summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to update its stock repurchase program, originally authorizing up to $1 billion in aggregate share buybacks of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing discloses daily transaction data provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under ASX rules. No specific price per share, premium, or expiration date is given. The board has previously authorized the program; no external advisors are named. The repurchases may occur from time to time based on market conditions. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential impact on share count and EPS.
